You are being evaluated on Continual-ARC, a lifelong stream of ARC-style grid puzzles.
Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object
on the last line of your reply:
  {"action": "submit", "grid": [[0, 1, 2], [3, 4, 5]]}   submit an output grid
  {"action": "request_demos"}                            ask for one more demonstration pair for this task
  {"action": "finish"}                                   end the instance, once it is over
Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

Scoring: an instance you solve costs 1 for each wrong submission and 1 for
each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

import numpy as np, os,re,json,itertools
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
inp1=np.array(G['Demo pair 1 input']); out1=np.array(G['Demo pair 1 output'])
inp2=np.array(G['Demo pair 2 input']); out2=np.array(G['Demo pair 2 output'])
# Transform: reflect each object cell about intersection axes (ar,ac); canvas = input minus last row/col? test all 4 crops and both axis choices.
def reflect(idx,a,n):   # reflect within [0,n-1]: idx> a -> 2a-idx, else idx; n unused
    return idx if idx<=a else 2*a-idx
def solve(I,O,drop_last=True):
    H,W=I.shape; OH,OW=O.shape
    vals,cts=np.unique(I,return_counts=True); bg=int(vals[cts.argmax()])
    order=sorted([(v,c) for v,c in zip(vals,cts) if v!=bg], key=lambda x:x[1])
    objc=order[0][0]; lc=order[-1][0]   # obj color = minority nonzero; line color
    # find intersection: rows where line color appears in full row / cols in full col
    rowfull=[r for r in range(H) if sum(I[r]==lc)==W]
    colfull=[c for c in range(W) if sum(I[:,c]==lc)==H]
    if len(rowfull)!=1 or len(colfull)!=1: raise Exception('no single axes')
    ar,ac=rowfull[0],colfull[0]
    # crop variant: which row/col removed
    pred=None
    for dr in [-1,None]:
        for dc in [-1,None]:
            if dr==-1 and O.shape[0]!=H-1: continue
            if dc==-1 and O.shape[1]!=W-1: continue
            sub=I[dr:] if dr else I
            sub=sub[:,dc:] if dc else sub
            if sub.shape!=(H-1,W-1): continue
            P=np.full((OH,OW),bg,dtype=int)
            for r in range(sub.shape[0]):
                for c in range(sub.shape[1]):
                    if sub[r,c]==objc:
                        pr,pc=max(0,min(ar-(abs(r-ar)),sub.shape[0]-1))
                        pc=max(0,min(ac-(abs(c-ac)),sub.shape[1]-1))
                        P[min(pr,O.shape[0]-1),min(pc,O.shape[1]-1)]=lc
            if dr==None and dc==None: pass
            hits=[]
            for sh in itertools.product(range(-2,3),range(-2,3)):
                Q=P[sh[0]:sh[0]+OH,sh[1]:sh[1]+OW]
                if Q.shape==(OH,OW) and np.array_equal(Q,O):
                    hits.append((dr,dc,sh))
    return hits
print('demo1 crops:',solve(inp1,out1))
print('demo2 crops:',solve(inp2,out2))

import numpy as np, os,re,json,itertools
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

# Alternative unified view: output canvas where each cell takes the value from the kaleidoscope tiling of the whole grid about intersection (tri mapping), with OBJ color cells recolored to line color, others KEEP their original colors — then crop last row/col. Check demo4!
def f(I,O=None):
    H,W=I.shape
    vals,cts=np.unique(I,return_counts=True); bg=int(vals[cts.argmax()])
    lc=None; objc=None
    for v in set(int(x) for x in I.flatten())-{bg}:
        rf=[r for r in range(H) if all(I[r]==v)]; cf=[c for c in range(W) if all(I[:,c]==v)]
        if rf and cf: lc=v
        else: objc=v
    ar,ac=[r for r in range(H) if all(I[r]==lc)][0],[c for c in range(W) if all(I[:,c]==lc)][0]
    def tri(n,a):
        p=2*a; ii=n%p; return a-abs(ii-a)
    U=np.array([tri(i,ar) for i in range(H)])
    V=np.array([tri(j,ac) for j in range(W)])
    F=I[U[:,None],V[None,:]]
    return np.where(F==objc,lc,F)[:-1,:-1]
for name in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4']:
    I=np.array(G[name+' input']); O=np.array(G[name+' output'])

def load():

    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):

G=load()

    def tri(n,a):
        p=2*a; ii=n%p; return a-abs(ii-a)

import numpy as np, os,re,json,itertools
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
# Hypothesis: kaleidoscope of the FULL input about intersection; then recolor obj->lc; then OUTPUT = crop to (H-1)x(W-1). Test variants.
for n in range(1,6):
    I=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {n} input']); O=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {n} output'])
    vals,cnt=np.unique(I,return_counts=True); bg=int(vals[cnt.argmax()])
    lc=None; objc=None
    for v in set(map(int,vals))-{bg}:
        rf=[r for r in range(I.shape[0]) if all(I[r]==v)]; cf=[c for c in range(I.shape[1]) if all(I[:,c]==v)]
        if rf and cf: lc=v
        elif lc is None: objc=v
    ar=[r for r in range(I.shape[0]) if all(I[r]==lc)][0]; ac=[c for c in range(I.shape[1]) if all(I[:,c]==lc)][0]
    H,W=I.shape
    def tri(n,a):
        p=2*a; ii=n%p; return a-abs(ii-a)
    U=np.array([tri(i,ar) for i in range(H)]); V=np.array([tri(j,ac) for j in range(W)])
    F=I[U[:,None],V[None,:]]
    P=np.where(F==objc,lc,F)[:-1,:-1]
    diff=(P!=O); mis=np.argwhere(diff)
    # check whether mismatch cells are exactly at boundary rows/cols or specific structure
    print('d',n,'diffs',len(mis))
    if len(mis):
        rows_m=set(i.tolist() for i,j in mis); cols_m=set(j.tolist() for i,j in mis)
        print('  rowset',sorted(rows_m),'colset',sorted(cols_m))

import numpy as np, os,re,json,itertools

    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])

    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G

import numpy as np, os,re,json,itertools,collections
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

results=[]
for n in [1,2,3,4,5,6,7]:
    I=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {n} input']); O=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {n} output'])
    H,W=I.shape
    vals,cnt=np.unique(I,return_counts=True); bg=int(vals[cnt.argmax()])
    fr=[r for r in range(H) if len(set(I[r]))==1]; fc=[c for c in range(W) if len(set(I[:,c]))==1]
    lc=I[fr[0],fc[0]]; ar,ac=fr[0],fc[0]
    objs=[v for v in set(map(int,I.flatten()))-{bg,lc}]
    obj=min(objs,key=lambda v:int((I==v).sum()))
    # candidate deltas for mirror axes (half-integer shifts)
    bd=[(-1,0),(0,-1),(-1,-1),(0,0)]+[tuple(float(x)/2) for x in [(-2,-2),(-1,-1),(0,0),(1,1),(2,2),(-1,1),(1,-1)]]
    best=None
    for dr,dc in bd:
        for dr2 in [round(dr), round(dr+0.5)] if False else [(round(dr),round(dc))]:
            pass
    # search dr,dc in {k/2} for k=-2..2
    for kr in range(-4,5):
        for kc in range(-4,5):
            dr=kr/2; dc=kc/2
            Sr=np.array([ar+dr-abs(((i+dr)*0+(kr%1==0 and i%2))) for i in range(O.shape[0])])
            # simpler: f(i)= (ar+dr) - abs( ((i - (ar+dr)) ) ) -- that's just reflection about ar+dr
            Sr=np.array([(ar+dr)-abs(i-(ar+dr)) for i in range(O.shape[0])])
            Sc=np.array([(ac+dc)-abs(j-(ac+dc)) for j in range(O.shape[1])])
            S=I[Sr[:,None],Sc[None,:]].astype(float)
            pred=np.where(((S==obj)|(S==lc)&True),lc,np.where(S==bg,bg,S))
            # recolor obj -> lc, lc -> lc, others unchanged? try obj&lc together
            pred=np.where((S==obj)|(S==lc),lc,np.where(S==bg,bg,S)).astype(int)
            cntm=int((pred!=O).sum())
            if best is None or cntm<best[0]: best=(cntm,kr,kc)
    results.append((n,'obj=%d'%obj,'lc=%d'%lc,'bg=%d'%bg,'best mismatch:',best))
for r in results: print(*r)

import numpy as np, os,re,json,itertools
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
for n in [5,6]:
    I=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {n} input']); O=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {n} output'])
    vals,cnt=np.unique(I,return_counts=True); bg=int(vals[cnt.argmax()]); lc=int(np.unique(I)[cnt==cnt.max()][1:].tolist()[0]) if False else int(np.unique(I)[cnt.argsort()[-2]][0])
    ar=[r for r in range(I.shape[0]) if sum(1 for c in range(I.shape[1]) if I[r,c]==lc)>=I.shape[1]*0.7][0]

    ys,xs=np.where((I!=bg)&(I!=lc))
    ho,y1=max(ys); wo,x1=max(xs); y0=min(ys); x0=min(xs); hT=y1-y0+1; wT=x1-x0+1

    found=[]
    for ry in range(hT+1):

            def vr(i): q=(i-ry)%(2*hT); return q if q<hT else 2*hT-q
            def hv(j): q=(j-rx)%(2*wT); return q if q<wT else 2*wT-q

import numpy as np, os,re,json,itertools
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
# Try: source row r(i), col c(j) = reflections of i,j about an axis a with wrap-around using refl(n,a)=a-abs(n%(2*a)-a).
for n in [5,6]:
    I=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {n} input']); O=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {n} output'])
    vals,cnt=np.unique(I,return_counts=True); bg=int(vals[cnt.argmax()]); lc=int(np.unique(I)[cnt.argsort()[-1]])
    ys,xs=np.where((I!=bg)&(I!=lc)); y0,y1,x0,x1=min(ys),max(ys),min(xs),max(xs)
    hT,wT=y1-y0+1,x1-x0+1; Q=I[y0:y1+1,x0:x1]
    Ho,Wo=O.shape
    best=None
    # vertical axis options: mirror sequence of period 2*hT anchored such that the reflected pattern equals tile height exactly: s(i) defined by fold over 2*hT where tile occupies rows... try axes a_v in range(hT+1)? 
    def vr(i,a,p):  # reflect i about point p, periodic with period 2*(hT-1)? 
        q = abs(i-p) % (2*hT-2) if False else None
        return ((i-p)%(2*hT)) if False else abs(i-p)%(2*hT-1) if False else 0
    # Use explicit sequences: s(i) = triangular wave with amplitude hT, period 2hT, phase p: value = hT - |((i+p)% (2hT)) - hT|
    for phv in range(2*hT):
        sv=lambda i: hT-abs(((i+phv)%(2*hT))-hT)
        for phc in range(2*wT):
            sw=lambda j: wT-abs(((j+phc)%(2*wT))-wT)
            P=np.full((Ho,Wo),bg,dtype=int)
            for i in range(Ho):

            m=int((P!=O).sum())
            if best is None or m<best[0]: best=(m,phv,phc)

import numpy as np, os,re,json,itertools
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
for n in range(1,9):
    I=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {n} input']); O=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {n} output'])
    vals,cnt=np.unique(I,return_counts=True); bg=int(vals[cnt.argmax()]); lc=int(np.unique(I)[cnt.argsort()[-1]])
    ar=[r for r in range(I.shape[0]) if sum(1 for c in range(I.shape[1]) if I[r,c]==lc)>=I.shape[1]*0.7][0]
    ac=[c for c in range(I.shape[1]) if sum(1 for r in range(I.shape[0]) if I[r,c]==lc)>=I.shape[0]*0.7][0]
    ys,xs=np.where((I!=bg)&(I!=lc)); y0,y1,x0,x1=min(ys),max(ys),min(xs),max(xs)
    print(f'd{n}: ar={ar} ac={ac} tile{y1-y0+1}x{x1-x0+1} out{O.shape} predH={2*ar} predW={2*ac}')
